spec.assertion: Structural: hitCount trigger, count 60, target enemy, durationSec 3 with no durationShots. Runtime: >=5 boss-held buffApply events (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) at value 12.56. Counterfactuals: dropping it lowers HER total AND moves at least one teammate (fails the nearest-wrong 'self buff' model, which would leave teammates byte-identical); stretching 3s->30s raises team damage (fails a permanent-debuff model, which would be identical).

Structural: flatDamage 158.43 lives in skill1 on a hitCount:60 / enemy block with requiresCore falsy. Runtime: removing it strictly lowers her total while every teammate stays byte-identical — fails both the 'declared but inert' model and any model that routes the rider through a shot/gauge channel.

Structural: instantReload on a self-targeted hitCount:60 block with a numeric fraction in (0.04, 0.11) ≈ 20/300. Counterfactuals: dropping it lowers her total (fails 'reload lines are defensive, skip'); forcing fraction:1 raises her total (fails the nearest-wrong full-magazine-refill model, which an omitted fraction would silently produce).

Doubling trigger.count on the debuff-carrying block must (a) find a hitCount trigger at all — proving trigger identity is hitCount, not shotFired/interval — and (b) roughly halve the proc count (halfProcs < baseProcs and halfProcs*2 > 0.7*baseProcs). A threshold that does not drive the proc rate, or a non-hitCount trigger, fails.

Structural: flatDamage 109.64 in skill2, target enemy, AND core-conditioned in some form — requiresCore:true OR a hitCount threshold >60 — plus threshold >= the S1a threshold. This fails the nearest-wrong model (a plain hitCount:60 clone of S1a with no core conditioning), which would fire the rarer core line as often as the normal-hit line and over-credit it. Runtime: removing it lowers her total with teammates byte-identical. The exact cadence (60 core hits = 60/coreRate normal hits) is it.skip'd — the engine has no core-hit counter and the core rate is measurement-gated.

Structural: fullBurstEnter trigger, self target, ownBurstGate undefined, durationSec 10, no durationShots, stat critRatePct. Runtime: applies exactly fullBurstStart-many times and only ever to her own slug — fails a burstCast key (fires on her casts only, pre-FB) and an ownBurstGate:'cast' model whenever helm completes a rotation. Also asserts zero critRateNormalPct@14.6 applies (nearest-wrong scoped-crit key). Counterfactuals: dropping it lowers her total with teammates byte-identical; retargeting to allies moves teammates, proving the self scope is load-bearing.

Structural: buff atkPct 62.54 on a burstCast/self block in the burst slot. Runtime: buffApply carries the RAW percentage with casterIdx===targetIdx and no durationShots — fails a casterAtkPct encoding (which re-emits flat ATK, so the 62.54 filter finds nothing). Counterfactual: dropping it lowers her total with teammates byte-identical.

Structural: buff reloadSpeedPct 67.2 on a burstCast/self block in the burst slot. Runtime: rs.expiresFrame - atk.expiresFrame === 600 frames (both applied on the same cast frame), which fails any 10s/10s or 20s/20s copy-paste and any permanent encoding. Counterfactual: dropping it lowers her total (reload speed gates shots on a 201-frame MG reload); deliberately no teammate-inertness claim, since her shot count feeds burst gauge.

fixtures: controlComp('ludmilla-winter-owner', true) only — liter B1 / crown B2 / ludmilla B3 / helm B3, boss Fire, focus on the carry. B1+B2 are mandatory because a lone Burst III unit makes ZERO full bursts, which would make every burst-keyed line vacuous. helm is deliberately KEPT as a second B3: she competes for the B3 cast, so ludmilla does not necessarily burst on every rotation, which is what makes the 'critRatePct applies === fullBurstStart count' assertion discriminate fullBurstEnter from burstCast / ownBurstGate:'cast'. helm's crit line uses the distinct critRateNormalPct key and cannot collide with any value-filtered assertion here. 13 hoisted runs total (1 baseline + 12 counterfactuals), all deterministic (no seed). Structural assertions read a clone of the shipped override captured through withPatchedOverride's mutate callback, so no committed JSON is touched and no fs access is needed.
gaps: skill2 'Activates when hitting the Core for 60 time(s)' — the exact core-hit cadence is it.skip'd: the engine's hitCount primitive counts landed rounds and requiresCore is only an exposure gate, so the faithful threshold is 60/coreRate, a Hit-Rate→core derived magnitude that is measurement-only (always-flag field #7). The test still asserts the line is core-conditioned in SOME form and never fires more often than the 60-normal-hit line.

Reload-economy lines (S1b instantReload, burst reloadSpeedPct) carry no teammate-inertness assertion by design — they change her shot count, hence burst-gauge generation, hence the team's rotation, so a teammate delta there is legitimate rather than a defect.

Rider noFb / noRange / crit flags on the two flatDamage lines are not asserted: per the shared taxonomy these are engine-global conventions (riders take FB by timing, range is force-off, crit eligibility is a global gate), not per-kit values, and the kit text gives no basis to pin any of them blind.
